# Arthur Bernard — Portfolio

> DevOps & Cloud Engineer based in France, former 42 student (core curriculum completed).
> Focused on automation, infrastructure as code, CI/CD and cloud-native technologies.
> Working stack: AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, Ansible, GitHub Actions, Python, Bash, Prometheus, Grafana, Loki.

The site is fully bilingual: every page exists under `/en/` (English) and `/fr/` (French),
with identical slugs. Links below point to the English version.

## Main pages

- [Homepage](https://arthurbernard.dev/en/): projects, background, contact
- [Resume](https://arthurbernard.dev/en/resume): experience, skills, education
- [Blog](https://arthurbernard.dev/en/blog/): long-form posts on career switch, learning and infrastructure projects
- [Tech Radar](https://arthurbernard.dev/en/tech-radar/): weekly tech-watch editions, automated with Python and Claude
- [Tech Radar methodology](https://arthurbernard.dev/en/tech-radar/methodology/): how the watch pipeline is built and reviewed

## Blog articles

- [From Pastry to Development](https://arthurbernard.dev/en/blog/from-pastry-to-development): career switch from pastry chef to engineer

- [AWS Infrastructure Automation With Terraform & Ansible](https://arthurbernard.dev/en/blog/aws-terraform-ansible): IaC project on AWS Free Tier
- [How I Failed My Criteo Interview](https://arthurbernard.dev/en/blog/criteo-interview): post-mortem on a missed SRE interview
- [How I Landed My Internship at Alan](https://arthurbernard.dev/en/blog/landing-alan-internship): Python learned in 10 days, 4-step process
- [My Learning System: Obsidian + Claude](https://arthurbernard.dev/en/blog/obsidian-claude-learning-system): GitHub repo as knowledge vault, AI-assisted learning without dependency
- [Weekly Tech Radar](https://arthurbernard.dev/en/blog/weekly-tech-radar): automated tech-watch pipeline with Python and Claude Haiku, and keeping engineer control over AI output
- [Keeping the Controls When AI Codes](https://arthurbernard.dev/en/blog/working-with-ai): how I work with AI without delegating my judgment, using my own site as the example
- [The Day I Took Down Production](https://arthurbernard.dev/en/blog/the-day-i-broke-prod): how a small change took down an internal tool, and what the incident taught me about hidden dependencies and rollbacks
- [I Was the SPOF](https://arthurbernard.dev/en/blog/the-spof-was-me): how an incident revealed I was a single point of failure, and how documentation and scaled communication fixed it
